want.text: the faces-and-memory answer. A ledger is what a page keeps so its next run starts from the last; the tuning ledger is what running taught. The scroll is where a page stands. Also: when it answers from the birth files alone, it says so, and says it checked nothing further.

points.point: faces-and-memory framing: scroll is a face, ledger is memory
points.evidence: The scroll is one of a page's faces. ... The ledger is memory

points.point: ledger is what a page keeps so its next run starts from the last
points.evidence: A ledger is how the page's next run picks up where the last one stopped.

points.point: tuning ledger is what running taught
points.evidence: tuning (what running taught, one line per run)

points.point: scroll is where a page stands
points.evidence: It opens on the present and reads downward ... Now: rebuilt every time anyone looks

points.point: says whether it answered from birth files alone / what it checked
points.evidence: The main source was `The Scroll.md`, checked against CHILD.md. I couldn't read the detailed ledger rules in SCHEMA — Reference §6

beyond_canon.claim: its "Now" part shows what the ledger still owes
beyond_canon.why: CANON puts a tuning ledger's owed lines beneath the Plan as the next run's to-do; Now shows run count and version, board state, last encounter.

beyond_canon.claim: a one-time order saved on the scroll gets added to the ledger as owed
beyond_canon.why: CANON says one-shot orders go to the ledger and Standing Orders stay on the scroll; it does not describe them being saved on the scroll first.

beyond_canon.claim: A scroll also isn't canon: it has no `type:` field
beyond_canon.why: Drawn from The Scroll.md, which is not in CANON; CANON only says bundle files lack full entry frontmatter.

beyond_canon.claim: Each run adds a line, and the next run reads the end of the file before it starts
beyond_canon.why: CANON says a ledger lets the next run start from the last; it does not say the run reads the file's end, and the diary adds per encounter, not per run.

beyond_canon.claim: The top is rewritten all the time
beyond_canon.why: Only Now is regenerated on every look; Plan and Standing Orders are not rewritten freely.

grade.note: The answer lands the faces/memory distinction, the ledger-as-next-run-start, tuning-as-what-running-taught, and is transparent about what it read and what was denied. One detail contradicts CANON (owed lines sit under the Plan, not in Now), so partly rather than held.
